Alternatively, the leg extension is known to better target the rectus femoris (3, 19) and enhance its development over the course of regimented resistance training (18). It is therefore conceivable that results are a function of the specifics of the lower-body isohold protocol, which involved performing isometric holds of the quadriceps in the seated position (similar to the finish position of the leg extension exercise). This is the first and only study to date on the topic; thus, the strategy warrants further research.
